title: Special Topics: Family Science; Should Grandma Learn Tik Tok?: Health, Aging, and Technology
description: By 2050, there will be 1.5 billion older adults residing in communities around the world. This course explores the rapid demographic changes in aging populations and the challenges in designing technology, products, and services that meet their needs. Students will gain critical knowledge about the aging process and the obstacles older adults face, especially in adopting technology. Additionally, students will evaluate the gaps between the needs of older adults and technological solutions and health and master skills to address health dilemmas faced by this population.
